approval.reason: Regenerated source run. The store replenishment policy replenished to 14 days of cover plus 3 units of safety stock, reviewed weekly, with one day of transit -- faster than any store could sell, so no store ever ran out. Zero-stock cells were 0.48 per cent and the in-stock rate 99.08, which left every availability and fill-rate measure saturated. At seven days of cover, one unit of safety stock and two days of transit the same simulation produces 9.39 per cent zero-stock cells and an 82.67 per cent in-stock rate, inside the range the approved reference shows.
